PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL EMPLOYEES SERVICE (AMENDMENT) RULES, 2003
PAKISTAN BAR COUNCIL EMPLOYEES SERVICE
(AMENDMENT) RULES, 2003
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, dated 15th September,
2003]
S.R.O. 906(I)/2003, dated 3-9-2003.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by section 55 of the Legal Practitioners arid Bar Councils Act, 1973
(XXXV of 1973) and all other enabling provisions in this behalf, the Pakistan
Bar Council 'hereby makes the following amendments in, "The Pakistan Bar
Council Employees Service Rules, 1976".
1. Name and commencement.--(1) These Rules may be called "The
Pakistan Bar Council Employees Service (Amendment) Rules, 2003."
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Rule 30.--(1) The existing clause (iii) of Rule 30
be substituted by the following:--
"(iii) He
resigns after completion of 10 years of continuous service or on the eve of
marriage of his daughter/son. In case the gratuity is availed under this Rule,
the same shall be deducted from the amount of gratuity admissible to the
concerned employees at the end of his service:
Provided that an employee having
put in 25 years' continuous service shall be entitled to the payment of 80
percent. of the total amount of gratuity admissible to him. The said, payment
shall, however, be adjusted at the time of his resignation or retirement.
(2) The word "gratuity"
occurring at the end of clause (V) of Rule 30 may be substituted by the words
"two months salary, each for the years of service put in by an
employee".
